penalties.details: A Mobile Oil Spill Recovery Unit (MOSRU) was delivered at WRPL Kot on 15.08.2025. To ensure legal operation and emergency readiness, mandatory third-party insurance and statutory registration under RTO, Rajasthan were required. The temporary registration of vehicle was valid till 10.12.2025 and temporary insurance till 03.09.2025. During permanent registration, the Transport Department imposed a penalty of Rs. 40,819/-, citing the rule that vehicles must be registered within 30 days of purchase or entry into the State.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Various disallowances amounting to Rs. 1194.07 crore as per the Assessment Order for Assessment Year 2016-17. CIT(A), vide order dated 23 October 2025, has disposed of the matter by partly allowing the appeal. Through the appellate order, relief amounting to Rs. 1,102.91 crores have been obtained on account of issues decided in favour of the Corporation, as against contested disputed tax and interest of Rs. 1,194.07 crores. The Corporation will be contesting the balance disputed tax of Rs. 91.16 crores before the higher forum i.e. Income-tax Appellate Tribunal.
tax_litigation.status: Appeal partly allowed by CIT(A) vide order dt. 23.10.2025 allowing relief of Rs. 1,102.91 cr. Appeal before ITAT has been filed by the company for seeking relief towards balance disputed tax of Rs. 91.16 cr. Same is pending as on date. Against the order of CIT(A), Income-tax Department has also filed an appeal before the ITAT on 31-12-2025 contesting disputed tax of Rs. 905.71 cr. Said appeal is pending as on date

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Show Cause Notice (SCN) raised on Indian Oil proposing Demand of Excise duty of Rs.4002 crore on the ethanol portion contained in Ethanol Blended Motor Spirit (EBMS) sold by IndianOil during the period 01.03.2014 to 31.12.2018. The SCN was adjudicated by Commissioner, Mumbai and IndianOil got a favourable order vide Order in Original (OIO) dated 06.02.2023 and concluded the proceedings. Against the said OlO, department has filed the appeal which has been admitted by CESTAT, Mumbai vide order dated 06.09.2023 (received on 28.09.2023) and the case would be listed for merit hearing
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Commissioner Central Goods and Service Tax, Mumbai East
tax_litigation.status: Departmental appeal admitted by CESTAT, Mumbai. Case pending for merit hearing.

timeline.summary: On 27 April 2026, Indian Oil Corporation reported a hydrocarbon discovery in its overseas exploration block in Libya.
On May 16, 2026, Indian Oil Corporation informed the exchange that ICRA assigned [ICRA] AAA Stable and [ICRA] A1+ ratings to its bank facilities.
Indian Oil Corporation Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 per equity share on May 18, 2026.
IOC board approved a 50:50 JV with M11 Energy for a ₹1,064 Cr HEFA-based SAF project at Paradip.
On 19 May 2026, Indian Oil's investor handout for FY26 showed standalone PAT of ₹36,802 Cr, record 75.5 MMT refinery throughput and an FY27 capex target of ₹32,700 Cr.
Indian Oil filed the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 25, 2026.
